description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions related to support packets in the Mattermost server, including diagnostics, stats, job lists, permissions, configuration, plugins, database schema, and options handling.

classes.name: SupportPacketDiagnostics
classes.description: Holds diagnostic information about the support packet, including server, database, license, and environment details.

classes.name: SupportPacketStats
classes.description: Contains statistical data about users, posts, channels, and webhooks for the support packet.

classes.name: SupportPacketJobList
classes.description: Lists recent enterprise job runs such as LDAP sync, data retention, message export, and elastic indexing jobs.

classes.name: SupportPacketPermissionInfo
classes.description: Contains roles and schemes information for permissions included in the support packet.

classes.name: SupportPacketConfig
classes.description: Encapsulates the Mattermost configuration along with feature flags.

classes.name: SupportPacketPluginList
classes.description: Lists enabled and disabled plugins for the support packet.

classes.name: SupportPacketDatabaseSchema
classes.description: Represents the database schema, including tables, columns, indexes, and options.

classes.name: DatabaseTable
classes.description: Represents a database table with columns and indexes.

classes.name: DatabaseColumn
classes.description: Represents a column within a database table.

classes.name: DatabaseIndex
classes.description: Represents an index on a database table.

classes.name: FileData
classes.description: Holds filename and binary content for files included in support packets.

classes.name: SupportPacketOptions
classes.description: Options for generating support packets, including log inclusion and plugin hooks.

methods.name: SupportPacketOptionsFromReader
methods.description: Decodes JSON-encoded support packet options from an io.Reader.
